cacheAdvice.policy: POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED on completed checksum-read ranges <= 16 MiB for files >= 8 MiB
cacheAdvice.scope: Read-only original bytes and identical SHA-256. Advice is not guaranteed eviction; no source synchronization, edits or global cache drop.

originalRoadKeys.scope: Three existing numeric arrays retained by reference; excludes object/allocator overhead. No per-road ID strings or membership set.

ioLifetime.scope: Per-file advice after successful completed reads; fdatasync only on newly owned outputs, including bounded completed export ranges. Kernel advice is not guaranteed eviction; no source-byte edits or global cache drop.

reusedQualification.scope: Checksum-verified existing qualification on the identical graph; no new route/search measurements

sampling.scope: Periodic samples can miss brief composition peaks. Field maxima are not simultaneous and must not be summed. memory.peak is a separate cumulative kernel counter; host/VM paging is unmeasured.

scope: Exact frozen graph/audit/source/packed parity with member-only lookup entries and a global per-way duplicate scan. Same resolver guard position and conservative fallback. Fresh small-fixture oracle checks; prior full/bounded/partial/native qualification reused on identical regional bytes. No fresh regional searches or coverage.
